draft.emotion: a quiet, heavy feeling of sorrow that slows your breath
notes: Describes both a person feeling sorrow and something that causes sorrow (such as news or a story). The masculine plural is irregular: حَزَانَى (ḥazānā) or حِزَان (ḥizān).
Differs from كَئِيب (depressed, gloomy), which describes a deeper or more lasting low mood.
